Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP + evaluation timeline for Acme Retail

Emily — great speaking earlier. As discussed, attaching our proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and initial SOW draft to align on evaluation milestones, contracting handoffs, and an expected close window. High level: 

- Goal: Production pilot by the end of Oct 2025 (pilot scope: search re-ranking on product pages, ~100k queries/day)
- Evaluation plan: 2-week ingest & validation, 3-week A/B in staging, 2-week performance verification
- MAP milestones (owner / target):
  • Discovery complete (Acme / Redwood) — Sep 19 — owner: Emily
  • Eval dataset delivery — Sep 22 — owner: Acme
  • Pilot deployment in staging — Oct 6 — owner: Redwood (ENG)
  • Contract signed (SOW + T&Cs) — Oct 9 — owner: Acme procurement + Redwood legal

Please note the contracting milestone above is our suggested target to meet your internal Q4 rollout. We've also flagged an optional extended review period if your legal team requires more rounds.

Attachments: MAP_Proposed_v1.xlsx, SOW_Draft_v0.9.pdf

Next steps: can we lock a 30-min contracting touchpoint this week to introduce legal/terms owners and confirm redline turnaround SLA? Priya (cc'd) is holding contracting coordination on our side and Rishi is our legal point for redlines.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick items from procurement/legal so we can confirm internal alignment: 

1) Can you confirm the redline process and expected turnaround for an initial redline from our side? We typically allow 5 business days, but if Redwood can commit to reviewing/countering within 3 business days that would help our timeline.
2) Who will be the formal terms owner on Redwood's side for indemnity/data use clauses? We need a single point to negotiate those items.
3) Do you have a procurement checklist (insurance, SOC, data processing addendum) we should use to avoid back-and-forth?

Happy to take a 20-minute sync on Wed or Thu — would like to include our legal (J. Adler) and procurement distribution.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Senior Manager, Vendor Programs
Acme Retail

Emily — thanks for the quick questions. I’ll summarize our internal approach so procurement/legal have a single, concrete view.

Redline process and SLAs:
- Initial redline window: Acme sends redline v1 -> Redwood legal acknowledges within 1 business day.
- Redwood initial review turnaround: 3 business days target for first pass comments (we can compress to 2 days for high-priority items; please flag).
- Final sign: we aim to complete countersign within 5 business days after comment resolution if there are no material new asks.

Terms owner and contact:
- Primary Redwood terms owner (legal): Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.com). He will own T&Cs, indemnity, and data-use language.
- Contracting coordinator (non-legal): Priya Natarajan (cc) — I’ll manage milestone tracker, signatures, and escalation if we hit blockers.

Procurement checklist / evidence bundle: attached contracting_milestones_tracker.csv. Additionally we will provide a one-page procurement packet (insurance certificate, SOC2 summary, DPA template) within 24 hours of request.

Proposed contracting milestones (short):
- Acme sends redline v1 — target Sep 18
- Redwood returns comments — Sep 22
- Final SOW agreed — Oct 2
- Signatures complete — Oct 9

If Wed/Thu works for you, Vivek — can we do Thu 09:30 PT? I’ll invite Rishi and Laura (ops) so we can walk the MAP and agree on redline SRs.

Best,
Priya
Head of Strategic Contracts | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (646) 555-0199

Emily, Priya — quick legal note on the SOW/T&Cs we circulated: 

- Indemnity: our standard position is mutual limited indemnity for third-party IP claims tied to use of our hosted inference service. If Acme requires a broader carveout for certain regulated data classes, flag the specific sections and we can propose language.
- Data processing: we will attach our DPA as an addendum to the SOW. That will cover roles, subprocessors, and retention windows for the pilot.
- Redline logistics: please upload redline v1 to the DocuSign link below (or reply with track changes). We prefer a single consolidated PDF with comments to accelerate our review.

DocuSign link for initial exchange: https://www.docusign.com/exec/ABC12345

I will aim for a 3-business-day turnaround for initial review. If there are material edits to indemnity or liability caps I’ll flag immediately and we can triage in a short call.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
